suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 concerns unsafe deserialization of Kotlin build-cache metadata. Dependency-Check associates the finding with kotlin-stdlib, but the affected functionality is Kotlin build infrastructure rather than the JVM runtime code shipped by this application. The application does not execute or consume Kotlin compiler/build-cache metadata at runtime. Kotlin 2.4.20 is the documented fixed version, but it is not yet listed as a stable release at the time of this review (2.4.20-RC2 as of Aug 2026). Reassess when the fixed stable release is available. Note: this finding intermittently disappears/reappears across scan runs depending on NVD data cache state — do not remove this suppression based on a single clean scan.

Spring Framework 6.2.0-6.2.19 (Spring Boot 3.5.16's managed version). These CVEs are matched by CPE against the whole org.springframework product/version, so they surface on whichever Framework jar happens to be present (spring-core, spring-tx, spring-web, etc.) rather than a fixed artifact name — scope by groupId, not individual artifact. Fix (6.2.20) is Enterprise Support Only; Spring Boot 3.5.16 was the final OSS release of the 3.5.x generation (OSS support ended 2026-06-30). No free OSS patch exists on this line. The free supported upgrade path is Spring Boot 4.x (Framework 7.x), tracked as a separate migration item. Accepted temporarily pending that migration.

CVE-2026-59270 (Spring Security embedded UnboundID LDAP server exposes a well-known admin credential on all interfaces). Matched by CPE against the whole org.springframework.security product/ version, so it surfaces on whichever Security jar happens to be present (spring-security-core, -web, -oauth2-jose, etc.) — scope by groupId, not individual artifact. Fix is Enterprise Support Only on the 6.5.x line; OSS fix is Spring Security 7.0.7/7.1.1. Accepted temporarily because the fixed patch is Enterprise Support Only on the current OSS line; application configuration must be reviewed to confirm this application does not wire up UnboundIdContainer or spring.ldap.embedded.* properties, which are the precondition for exploitability. Do not treat as universally non-exploitable without that review. Tracked for the Boot 4.x migration.
